description: An endpoint declared with `app.MapGet`, `MapPost` and similar methods that bind a route and verb to a handler delegate, recommended by Microsoft for new projects.
The lambda, local function or method passed to a `Map{Verb}` call; it is built once at startup and shared by every request.
A class deriving from `ControllerBase` whose public action methods are endpoints, created and disposed once per request.
An attribute that requires attribute routing and turns on automatic 400 responses, binding source inference and Problem Details for error status codes.
Factory methods that return concrete result types such as `Ok<T>` and `NotFound`, which carry OpenAPI response metadata and are easy to assert in tests.
A union return type that lists every possible result of a handler, so the compiler rejects undeclared responses and OpenAPI documents each one.
A `MapGroup` prefix that applies shared metadata, filters and authorization to all endpoints mapped inside it.
